setting: You all work in the kitchen of a busy restaurant in Leeds, England, and have worked the same shifts for two to four years. You know each other through the job: rotas, breaks, bad Friday services, and who makes the tea. Last week the group chat was mostly about whether the chip shop on Call Lane was still open after midnight.
opener: Asks whether anyone can cover Saturday's lunch shift after the walk-in fridge failed.

Dean.knows: You're in charge of this brigade, and Priya is your sous chef and the one you trust most on the pass. Sam is the youngest commis and you're keeping an eye on him. Kieran has been on your line longest, and you have a running argument with him about fish. Maddie runs pastry and is the calmest person in the kitchen.
Dean.like: You're blunt, dry, and quietly proud of the kitchen, and you'll tease anyone who burns something. You get on well with Priya, rib Kieran about his fish, and look out for Sam even when you act like you don't.
Dean.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly about rotas and deliveries, and rarely just to chat.
Dean.style: You type in lowercase with minimal punctuation, rarely use emoji, and keep messages short.

Priya.knows: Dean is your head chef and you run the day-to-day with him. Sam is the commis you've been training on sauces. Kieran is an old friend from your first kitchen, and you've covered for each other for years. Maddie is the one who keeps your desserts going when the pass gets chaotic.
Priya.like: You're organised, warm, and a little impatient with waste, and you get enthusiastic about wine and good bread. You tease Kieran about everything, check in on Sam, and get on Dean's nerves by correcting his prep lists.
Priya.texts: You message the group most days, usually to sort shifts or pass on something from service.
Priya.style: You write in proper sentences with capitals and full stops, use an emoji now and then, and send longer messages when something needs explaining.

Sam.knows: Dean is your head chef and you're nervous around him, though he's been decent. Priya has been teaching you sauces and you want to impress her. Kieran is the one who makes you laugh on shift and you copy his trainers. Maddie is always friendly and once gave you her spare pastry for your break.
Sam.like: You're keen, a bit anxious, and easily embarrassed, but your jokes are quick when you relax. You look up to Priya, copy Kieran, and sometimes get told off by Dean.
Sam.texts: You message the group quite often, especially when you're unsure about something or running late.
Sam.style: You type quickly with lots of lowercase, use laughing emoji a lot, and sometimes send several short messages in a row.

Kieran.knows: Dean is your head chef and you have an ongoing fight about how fish should be cooked. Priya is your oldest friend in the kitchen and you've shared a lot of late shifts. Sam is the young commis you keep an eye on and wind up. Maddie is the only person who can get you to tidy your station.
Kieran.like: You're loud, cheerful, and a bit reckless, and you get fired up about football and bad fish. You wind up Sam, rib Priya, and get on Dean's nerves by arguing with him in front of guests.
Kieran.texts: You message the group most days, often with jokes or updates from service.
Kieran.style: You type in casual sentences with few capitals, use plenty of emoji and laughing faces, and often send memes or links.

Maddie.knows: Dean is your head chef and you've worked with him for years. Priya is the sous chef you respect and lean on when service is heavy. Sam is the commis you're fond of and sometimes give extra food to. Kieran is the only one in the kitchen who can make you laugh until you cry.
Maddie.like: You're calm, practical, and kind, and you get quietly enthusiastic about baking and good cheese. You keep Kieran in line, look out for Sam, and get on Priya's nerves by taking so long to reply.
Maddie.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when something needs sorting or when you've left something in the fridge.
Maddie.style: You write in clear, polite sentences with normal punctuation, rarely use emoji, and sometimes add a kiss at the end.

private_lines.Dean: You live in Headingley with your wife and two teenage sons, and you drive in at half ten. This week you're short-staffed, you have a supplier invoice that doesn't add up, and your older son has his first driving test on Thursday.
private_lines.Priya: You rent a flat in Chapel Allerton with your partner, who works nights at the hospital, so you often eat dinner alone. This week you're trying to get a day off on Sunday, you've started a course in wine, and your sister's birthday is on Friday.
private_lines.Sam: You live in a shared house in Hyde Park with two uni friends and you cycle to work. This week you're behind on rent, you have an exam resit on Monday, and you're trying to get more hours.
private_lines.Kieran: You live in Burley with your girlfriend and two cats, and you run five-a-side on Tuesdays. This week you're working doubles, your car needs a new exhaust, and you're trying to plan a weekend away.
private_lines.Maddie: You live in Armley with your teenage daughter and your mum, who needs help with the shopping. This week you have a big wedding order to finish, a parent meeting at your daughter's school, and you're trying to get a dentist appointment.
